summary: The TypeScript DSL supports declared one-shot startup messages for OMP, Codex and Claude harnesses.

schema.detail: Uses the existing native harness message grammar; no storage changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional message records extend the DSL without changing existing declarations.

downtime.detail: No restart-time work; changing a declared message text or id restarts that agent.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Startup messages are delivered once per subject and message id.

recovery.detail: Remove the optional message field to restore a declaration without a startup message.
